subject: Data processing agreement request and subprocessor/scope confirmation
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finleyhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@finleyhealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data processing agreement & subprocessors — request for template and scope

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting procurement for a pilot with Redwood and need to get a DPA in place before we begin ingesting any customer data. Can you send your standard DPA template, current subprocessor list, and confirm how Redwood handles EU data transfers (SCCs, data residency options)?

Specific asks from our side:
- DPA template (preferably Word/PDF with track changes-friendly format)
- Current subprocessor roster and SOC 2 status for those subprocessors
- How you handle cross-border transfers and any ability to restrict processing to specific regions
- Typical turnaround for reviewing/negotiating redlines and executing (DocuSign/AdobeSign)

We’re aiming to sign by the end of next week if possible.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
Finley Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finleyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data processing agreement & subprocessors — Redwood materials attached

Hi Samantha — great to e-meet you.

Attached are: our standard Data Processing Agreement (redwood_dpa_template_20250715.pdf) and our current subprocessor roster (redwood_subprocessors_20250715.csv). Quick notes up front so you have context: 

- Subprocessors: the CSV lists active subprocessors and their SOC 2 or ISO attestations where available. We provide 30 days' notice before adding new subprocessors and maintain a public subprocessor page for audit purposes.
- Data transfers: for hosted customers we rely on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for transfers from the EU to the US. For customers needing stronger controls we offer Private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and routing to EU-only regions where available.
- Turnaround: for standard commercial terms we typically execute DPAs within 3–7 business days once redlines are limited to non-core legal items. More substantive redlines may require legal review which can add time.

Two asks from our side:
1) Please let us know whether Finley needs SCCs attached explicitly or if a clause reference is sufficient for your procurement team.
2) Any specific retention/logging limits you require (we have standard operational logs retention 90 days by default).

I’ve CC’d Marissa (privacy lead) and Karthik (legal ops) to help with any redlines and SOC 2 artifacts. If it helps, we can do a 20–30 minute call to walk through the subprocessor list.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_template_20250715.pdf, redwood_subprocessors_20250715.csv

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: proposed DPA redlines for Finley Health (privileged)

Internal note — please treat as privileged.

Kimberly / Karthik, review notes on the attached Redwood DPA:
- Section 4 (Subprocessors): confirm 30-day notice language is present and add an explicit right for Finley to object to new subprocessors on reasonable security grounds; propose a short escalation path (security contact) — acceptable commercially.
- Section 6 (Data transfers): we should offer two options: (a) standard SCCs clause for contract-level protection, and (b) optional Annex permitting EU-only routing for customers on Dedicated/Private. Suggest flagging this to Finley as a commercial upgrade with pricing caveat.
- Section 10 (Logs & retention): Finley asked about retention. Propose keeping operational logs at 90 days default and offering 30/90/180 day options as part of onboarding.
- Indemnity/limitation: our template limits liability; if Finley pushes, escalate to Legal (external counsel) — expect countersign if commercially material.

I’ll prepare a short redline set that keeps our standard protections but makes the SCCs and subprocessor notice language clearer.

-Marissa
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finleyhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@finleyhealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data processing agreement & subprocessors — Finley redlines attached

Kimberly, thanks for the quick turnaround and for the materials. We reviewed your DPA and attached a set of redlines (finley_redlines_dpa.pdf). High-level:

- We accept the 30-day notice but ask for an explicit objection process for critical subprocessors (health data handling).
- We request that SCCs be attached as an exhibit and referenced in the transfer clause (helps our procurement).
- We asked for confirmation that SOC 2 reports for listed subprocessors are current; legal requested latest SOC 2 Type II attestation for any subprocessor handling PHI.
- We prepared the DPA for signature and sent via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/mock/signer/XYZ-12345. Please review and sign by end of day tomorrow if you can.

I’ve CC’d our legal mailbox for tracking. If there are material concerns we can hop on a quick call — but ideally we keep this to a single redline round.

Best,
Samantha
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finleyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data processing agreement & subprocessors — executed

Samantha — thanks, and appreciate the clear redlines.

We reviewed Finley’s marked-up DPA; the changes were largely acceptable. Per Marissa’s note we attached SCCs as an exhibit and confirmed the 30-day notice + objection pathway wording. Karthik pulled the SOC 2 attestations for the three subprocessors listed as handling PHI and uploaded them to our secure share; Marissa will follow up with copies to your legal mailbox.

I signed the DocuSign document you sent and completed execution — attached is the fully executed agreement (executed_dpa_finley_redwood.pdf). Next steps:
- Marissa will send SOC 2 attestations to legal and confirm the subprocessor contact points.
- We’ll schedule a short onboarding call with your integrations lead to confirm data flows and controls (available next Tue/Wed).

Thanks again — excited to get the pilot started.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: executed_dpa_finley_redwood.pdf
